# Reading fixtures

These files exercise source navigation and goal display; they establish no new
mathematical verification. `lean-goals.json` records output for the
[Equational Theories project](https://github.com/teorth/equational_theories/tree/1aec8a7acf223b7c56e4830977b6e90d4ef1924b).
